title: A characteristic-zero counterexample to Lipman–Zariski

result.label: A characteristic-zero counterexample to Lipman–Zariski
result.statement: Constructs a singular normal affine complex surface with free rank-two tangent sheaf, disproving the characteristic-zero Lipman–Zariski conjecture.
